text:
alex: Heads-up — need a small burst of GPU capacity for an inference canary next Tue (us-west2). Can we borrow 1-2 A100s or an A10 from any spare/demo pool for ~2 hours? Trying to validate the new KV-cache hotpath under realistic load.

maya: How many concurrent requests and target p95 latency?

alex: Target ~4 concurrent QPS, p95 < 180ms, estimate ~15k tokens total across the run. Should only be 1-2 GPUs for 2hrs based on local perf.

jen: FYI the canary will run the new runtime branch (PR #4521) and uses longer context (~8k). We want to test model fallback too so prefer same-gen as production (A100) if possible.

maya: Got it. I'll check quota + active reservations. If we can't spare A100s we can try an A10 with heavier batching.

infra-bot: inventory-check: us-west2 available accelerators -> A100: 3 spare, A10: 7 spare, pending-reservations: 1. (query: `curl -s https://inventory.internal/api/v1/accels?zone=us-west2`)

alex: Nice — can you hold 2 A100s for a 2hr window 08:00-10:00 PDT next Tue? I'll add the canary window to the runbook and notify SRE.

maya: Tentatively yes, but need procurement confirmation for shared-demo borrow. @tariq can you approve a short borrow? I'll attach the runbook and cost estimate.

tariq: Quick check — is this a paid vendor reservation or internal demo pool borrow? If vendor we need a short PO and quota bump request. If internal demo pool, just file a ticket and tag me.

alex: Internal demo pool. I'll file infra ticket and add cost center ENG-PLAT-2.

jen: Two small notes: 1) add `--enable-prefix-cache` to canary command to validate the hotpath. 2) We'll fallback to the distil variant if latency jumps (auto-fallback enabled).

alex: Command snippet I'll run:
```
./run_canary.sh --model redwood-open-8k --gpus 2 --duration 7200 --enable-prefix-cache
```

maya: Filing ticket now: INFRA-8724. Holding 2 A100s for 08:00-10:00 PDT next Tue pending approval.

tariq: Approved for internal borrow, INFRA-8724 created. Please add telemetry tags: `env:canary`, `team:runtime`, `cost_center:ENG-PLAT-2`. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks everyone — I'll post the postmortem link after the run.

jen: One more ask: set a max price cap on preemptible fallback just in case. `budget->preemptible_max_usd = 2.5/hr` in the run config.

maya: Noted. I'll add that to the ticket.

infra-bot: ticket-update: INFRA-8724 status -> approved, resources reserved (2 x A100) for 2537337600-2537338800 (08:00-10:00 PDT next Tue).

alex: Perfect. Leaving this thread open for any last-minute changes.
